Notes_and_Tips: Keep rice portions consistent and moderate to control blood sugar.
Avoid skipping meals to prevent sugar dips and cravings.
Prefer pressure cooked or pan fried foods with minimal oil.
For spicy cravings, use spices without increasing oil.
Regular yoga and meal timing help glucose control.
Consistency in daily routine matters more than strict restriction.
